scope: Local pilot candidate only. Not a release policy or calibrated reliability claim. No held-out results have been opened.

category.rule: Require an available page and a selected specific category. cannot_determine is abstention. The observed minimum confidence among correctly decisive, available development category answers was 0.99 in each language.

readability.rule: Only the clear description may be shown when P(level 2) meets the language-specific observed minimum for available clear development pages. Otherwise abstain. Do not convert fractional Score to percent.
readability.unresolved: No development unreadable or partially readable case was run. Rules for the other two descriptions and their reliability are unresolved.

ar.rule: Abstain. There is no complete Arabic development comparison.

en.rule: Require an available comparison and complete selected-page coverage. Use the observed minimum correct native confidence for each observed outcome. conflicting and cannot_determine have no decisive display rule.

comparison.allLanguagesRule: A failed, unreadable, unchecked or incompatible-category page cannot establish agreement or absence. Financial averages require a displayed consistent reporting-period finding; otherwise suppress their decisive comparisons.

highlight.rule: Require available page, displayed clear readability, specific compatible category, presence above its language threshold, selected multiplicity single with P(single) above its language threshold, and valid positive-area geometry inside the actual raster. Scope to source/page/target. A highlight is still an empirical candidate whose correctness must be checked against the frozen source.
highlight.derivation: Presence thresholds use the lowest strong present-target values on available development pages, excluding the business-name presence miss at 0.41. Multiplicity thresholds use the lowest correctly single probabilities in available development pages. These choices trade coverage for caution and do not establish calibration.
highlight.boxConfidenceRule: No numeric Box-confidence cutoff is established. Nullable confidence is retained; it cannot independently establish presence or correctness.
highlight.unresolved: High Box confidence has not established full text containment, and live null Box confidence has not yet been observed.

failurePolicy: Strict native validation is unchanged. An invalid Box currently makes its whole page unavailable, including otherwise readable judgments. No repair calls are allowed. Record this loss of useful coverage.
releaseLimitations: Three source documents plus a repeated development probe cannot validate language-wide thresholds.
Partial financial comparison cannot establish complete conflict detection or actual four-page comparison context fit.
The pilot can fail zero-harm or coverage targets. Do not tune on held-out outcomes or make replacement calls.
